title: Kissed Midnight Korean Ricotta Wrapped-Leaf Ssam
description: A midnight-craving korean dish featuring ricotta, namul-blanch-season, and a touch of sweetness. This macrobiotic-friendly snack wraps the flavors of Korea into a delicious, gooey leaf.
instructions: Preheat a dry skillet to medium heat and toast sesame seeds until fragrant.
In a blender or food processor, blend ricotta cheese with gochujang, gochugaru, nama shoyu soy sauce, sesame oil, and honey until smooth.
Add grated ginger, garlic, and cilantro to the blender and blend until combined.
Heat the gochujang-ricotta mixture in a saucepan over low heat until warmed through.
Prepare leafy greens by blanching them in boiling water for 30 seconds and then rinsing with cold water.
To assemble the ssam, place a leafy green on a flat surface and dollop the gochujang-ricotta mixture in the center of the leaf.
Fold the leaf over the filling to form a tight package and serve immediately.
Repeat with remaining leaves and filling, serving as a snack or appetizer.
